Get the full 60 minute walk group walk for a discount.  Your dog will be walked at any time between 9.30am and 4.30pm, with no way of saying when, due to the variations in the day.  This walk is discounted as it is to fill holes.  On days that we are quiet, will will try and fit you in at your most desired time, but on busy days that is not guaranteed.  Only suitable for dogs that will walk with any other dogs.   Many dog walkers that advertise 60 minutes are now doing 45  so they do not have to increase their prices, but we have always been the premium company and will not cut the walks short without a serious need. £18 for two dogs anytime group walk. Many new dog walkers will promise you a set time, but as they get busier, your time will get moved, and you will end up with an anytime walk.  Some quiet days, you will get the time you desire, and on busier days you may not. This is what we do with this service, but we are transparent.  You know this is how it will work.
​
With so many beautiful places to go to take the dogs, we are all spoilt for choice.  Most range from short riverside walks to long, relaxing, peaceful walks on the moors.  Most walks are free from roads with heavy traffic and full of places to run and play.

Our service is designed for clients who are unable to take their dog out and give them what they need.  We are here to take the pressure away so you're able to get on with your day knowing that your dog has been exercised, had fun, played with friends and then is left at home without the stress of being left in a kennel for the day.

How does it work?

We will arrange a complimentary visit to you at your home at a time to suit yourself (often in the early evenings).  We will meet you and your dogs and get fully acquainted, answer all your questions and obtain a key.

All of our team of dog walkers are fully insured and registered.  Our insurance company is LRMS Insurance Services Limited, trading as: Pet Business Insurance.  Each team member is insured to walk up to six dogs at a time (maximum) but walks generally consist of four or less unless we are having a puppy party in a carefully selected area, where dog walkers meet up to socialise the dogs and let them have fun as they like it, the more the merrier and all certificates and references can be viewed.

Most insurance companies only insure up to a maximum of six dogs at any one time so dog walkers that walk more than six dogs at a time might not be insured.  However, we generally prefer to do groups of up to four dogs.  We are insured for six to ensure we can cover other team members in emergencies. On the day of the walk, your dog walker will pick your dog up at the agreed slot and take them out for a fun, off lead if it is safe, group walk with other dogs.  On return, they will generally leave them where they found them in your house unless told otherwise.  Aquasorbed down to ensure the bulk of the dirt is off.  Please have an available hose, or a suitable dog cleaner if they need extra attention, you know your dog better than anyone.  
 
 50% discount for each additional dog from the same address on the same walk.

After each walk we will hose the dogs down if there is a hose available, and aquasorb them off.  If you want a little extra, please leave out a clean towel for a final polish.  If you require any further cleaning, please see our extra clean service.

Here are a few pictures from today’s 35th Annual Hot Air Balloon Rodeo in Steamboat Springs, which is also happening Sunday morning, starting at 6 a.m. These pictures were taken from Bald Eagle Lake in Steamboat. I am the announcer for the event.
 
The first picture (014) is of the two hand-painted balloons in the Balloon Rodeo. There are only 12 hand-painted balloons in the world and these are two of them. The circus balloon is called Big Top and the cowboy balloon is called Western Spirit.
 
The second picture is a nice balloon shot except there was a man there with a unicorn head watching. It was interesting. I had to take his picture.
 
The third shot (003) is the Colorado High Balloon which is the Colorado state flag, and then the American Flag balloon, heading out over Bald Eagle Lake.
 
The next shot is five balloons over Bald Eagle Lake.
 
The last shot (002) shows the sun coming up behind the mountain. Submitted by Shannon Lukens.
